business_problem: Intralox needed to replace fragmented call center and CRM systems so it could serve global customers consistently, improve service productivity, and connect customer service and field service teams.
solution_summary: Intralox supports more than 80,000 accounts with over 500 customer service representatives and field technicians in 18 languages, but the company had accumulated a mix of call-center tools and CRM systems that made service handoffs and omnichannel support harder than they needed to be. Key components include Dynamics 365 Sales centralizes account and activity data for service and sales teams; Dynamics 365 Customer Service provides unified case management and omnichannel customer support workflows; Dynamics 365 Field Service manages work orders and field-service handoffs from the customer service organization; Dynamics 365 Contact Center adds localized 24/7 voice-capable access to customer information for remote support teams. Intralox reports efficiency gains in omnichannel effectiveness, work order administration, and case management while maintaining a 99.4 percent customer service accuracy rate.

data_flow: Customer requests from multiple channels enter Dynamics 365 Customer Service, where account context from Dynamics 365 Sales supports case handling and handoffs into Dynamics 365 Field Service. Voice interactions run through Dynamics 365 Contact Center, while service teams continue to use connected ERP and telephony systems as background integrations.

evidence_quotes: With Dynamics 365 we've seen impressive efficiency gains in omnichannel effectiveness, work order administration, and case management.
Intralox wanted a centralized system that would help it connect more closely with customers, improve the productivity of customer service and field service teams, and boost customer satisfaction.
With Microsoft Dynamics 365, we went from using several different systems that required redundant tasks, or had gaps in data flow, to a fully unified, secure, and easily managed solution.
